name: Heimdall
description: A simple start page for your apps.
compose:
services:
  heimdall:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/heimdall:latest
    container_name: heimdall
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:80"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: "{TZ}"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/config:/config
